tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ta)༄༅/ /dge 'dun dbyen 'dum gyi mchod rten chen po bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dwangs shel me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥgang la skyab
(ta)༄༅/ /dge 'dun dbyen 'dum gyi mchod rten chen po bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dwangs shel me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥgang la skyab

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dge 'dun dbyen 'dum gyi mchod rten chen po bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dwangs shel me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ gang la skyabs su song ba'i gom gcig gis// bsod nams sa gzhi yangs pa dbang bsgyur zhing*// lam log 'jigs pa'i dgra las rgyal byed pa// dkon mchog yon tan skabs gsum dbang pos skyongs// 'dren mchog thugs rje'i gdugs dkar grib ma'i 'od// chud tsam ngan 'gro 'khor ba'i tsha gdung las// bskyabs nas bde legs bsil ba'i go 'phang la// bkod mdzad rtsa brgyud bla mar phyag gi yul// shes bya kun la mkhas pa'i grags pa brnyes// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// rnam 'gyur drug gis 'gro rnams dga' bde'i sar// 'khrid mdzad dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs la 'dud// rnam 'dren zhi ba rang gi lung rtogs chos// tshul bzhin rnam par 'grel la mi'i skye bas// mkhas tshul gsum gyis las byas sa skya pa// yab sras khu dbon brgyud par bcas la 'dud// mdo sngags bstan pa'i chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i nyin byed 'od po ches// 'gro blo'i padma'i tshal bzhad kun dga' bzang*// yab sras brgyud par bcas rnams gtsug tu mchod// rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma'i mchog rnams las// zab rgyas sdom pa kunaṃ dgaṃ'i dpal bzung nas// ji bzhin 'doms la mkhas btsun bzang po yi// yon tan rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal// gang de'i 'gro 'dul gzugs sku'i chos dbyings su// spros pa brtul yang lha mis mchod pa'i rten// dge 'dun dbyen 'dum chos gzugs sku gnyis kyi// ring bsrel phung pos mngon par gtams gang zhig /dkar 'jam gzhi ma'i dwangs shel me long ngos// tshogs pa gsum pa'i mtshar sdug bzhin ras 'bum// byung tshul 'phrin snyan shod pa kārti kas// thos 'dzin bcu gnyis sprul nas mnyan min nam// bsung ldan 'dab stong tshal du sbrang rtsi'i mgrin// nyin bzhin 'phur lding snyan pa'i glu len pas// rten bzhengs mchod pa'i bsod nams phung po'i gtams// brjod pas zad mi shes pa mtshon nam kye// zhes shis brjod phyag bya dngos po nges bstan gyi tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas/

'dir skabs su bab pa gser gdung dge 'dun dbyen 'dum 'di'i ji ltar byung ba brjod pa la gsum ste/ gang gi ched du bskrun pa/ ji ltar brtsam pa'i tshul/ brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ spyir rang re rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che nyid de/ de'ang mgon po byams pas/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus// legs par bsrungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel bcas// de yi dbang gi shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar brjod bya rtogs pa'i chos dang*/ rjod byed bka' dang dgongs 'grel bcas pa yun ring du gnas dgos shing*/ de la'ang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams la rag las pa'ang*/ de 'dzin byed dang smra mkhas pa// sgrub pa byed pa kho na yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bstan 'dzin gyi gang zag bstan la mkhas pa'i bya ba byed pa mang du byon pa'i nang nas/ deng 'dir mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis yongs su gtams pa'i rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho pa zhes bya ba nyid de/ de'i sku che ba'i yon tan cung zad brjod na/ de'ang chung ngu'i skabs nas sngon dge'i bag chags bzang po sad pa'i ya rabs kyi spyod pa la gnas shing rang bzhin gyis dge ba'i lam la thugs 'dun cing*/ yig klog dang bslab sbyong 'os pa'i rigs la 'bad rtsol che zhing*/ cung zad nar son pa na/ bla ma kun dga' chos 'phel ba nas tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos nas/ ji skad du/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar// zhes pa ltar sdom pa'i bslab bya la legs par gnas shing*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i dngos slob ye shes phrin las bkra shis dbang phyug kun dga' chos 'phel/

bkra shis bzang po/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho pa rnams las rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang bka' byin rlabs rjes gnang sogs mang du thos shing*/ slar yang sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin legs par nod pa'i sdom ldan gyi dngos po sgrub slad/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan dang dpal sa skya sogs su byon nas de dag tu bla ma lha rten rnams mjal phyag byin rlabs chos 'brel zhu ba dang*/ khyad par skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i zhal snga nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs nas/ bslab bya'i gnas la mig 'bras ltar gces par bsrungs pa nas brtsams te/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba/ dpal rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bi rū pa'i bka' srol gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ skyes bu chung 'bring chen po rnams kyi zab khrid dang brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i sgo nas/ ji skad du/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar gyur// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi phyag mchod kyi gnas su gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom ldan du gyur/ slar yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba thog mar slob ma rjes bzung nas brtsams te/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba legs par nos nas gang zag rab 'bring gi khyad par gyis tshe 'di'am bar do/ 'bring skye ba bdun/ tha mas kyang skye ba bcu drug la sogs pa nas 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur ba bka' lung tshad mas nges par bstan pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom ldan du byas/

de dag dang 'brel bar dang pos las can gyi bslab bya'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsrung tshul dang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang bcas pa/ lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i dbang bzhi sngon du 'gro bas nang bskyed pa'i rim pa gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim gtum mo sher dbang dang 'brel ba'i phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor/ dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba'i lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs/ de dag gi lam yan lag dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa smin rgyas su mnos te/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po de nyid dang*/ bla ma slob dpon gzhan dag las kyang rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang bka' byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba rgyab brten lung gi rigs dang bcas pa thos pa mang pos nus ldan du gyur/ slar yang dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen pa'i zhal snga nas kyang chos 'brel dang*/ de dag gi phyogs kyi rten mjal phyag mchod 'bul ba sogs kyi tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong mdzad/ slar yang lha ldan phyogs kyi phyag skor tshogs bsags kyi rigs dang*/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub pa'i drung du'ang zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin mang du nod cing*/ dpal rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub pa/ gnas gsar zhabs drung kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas pa dang*/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho pa sogs gong du smos pa'i bla ma de dag las dbang khrid byin rlabs rig gtad rjes gnang lung gi rigs sogs thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son cing*/ de dag gi bar skabs kun du thos pa'i don rnams rgyud la sbyar ba'i bsnyen mtshams kyang kye rdo rje/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ kun rig tshe dpag med/ gur zhal/ las gshin sogs kyi bsnyen pa sbyin sreg bcas pa rnams/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su 'os pa thams cad tshul bzhin du bsgrubs shing*/

shar mgon khang gsol mchod kyi bla mar bskos nas lo shas song mtshams/ bkra shis ltems nas dpal sa dbang bsod nams mgon po pa nas sku bsrung par dgos tshul gyi bkod pa ltar der byon/ bsnyen mtshams sku rim dbang bskur gtor brgyab kyi rigs gang 'os bsgrubs nas lo shas bzhugs/ slar 'di phyogs su'ang gnam bskos gong ma chen pos gsan hu sis las rtags chen pos mdo khams phyogs kyi sa skyong du ma'i yang mes tshangs pa chen po lta bur mnga' gsol ba'i las thogs pa chos ldan gyi sa spyod blo gros rgya mtsho pa dral lcam bcas nas rigs kyi cod paṇa du mnga' gsol zhing*/ rdo rje gur mgon gyi dbang bka'i rigs dang*/ gur zhal la sogs pa bstan srung rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs rjes gnang gi rigs ma tshang ba med pa gsan gyin gzhi byes kun du sku'i bsrung ba 'bral med du spyan 'dren zhing*/ de dag gi bar mtshams kun tu skal ldan gyi slob ma rab 'bring tha ma gang la gang 'tshams kyi zab pa dang*/ rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa'i sgo nas bla ma gong ma'i phrin las rjes su bskyangs nas/ slar yang gdul bya skal dman rnams dge la bskul ba dang*/ le lo can rnams brtson 'grus bskyed pa dang*/ rtag 'dzin can rnams mi rtag pas rgyud bskul ba'i slad du/ mya ngan bsal ba las/ 'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyi// mdun na yod pa 'chi ba ste// sa'am 'on te mtho ris na// skyes nas la la ma shi ba// 'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am// thos sam 'on te the tshom za// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ zhag shas su cung zad smyung ba'i tshul bstan mthar/ snang mched thob gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog dbyings su nub pa'i 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du mdzad pa'i ngang nas 'da' ka ma zab mo'i lam la brten nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so// gnyis pa mchod rten ji ltar brtsams pa la/

de nas mi bdag chen pos bka'i gnang ba ltar/ gnyen 'brel rnams nas dpal ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho gas spur sbyangs nas/ gdung rus rnams kyang sbyong rgyal gyi sngags 'bum phrag bzlas pa'i rus sbyong byas nas sātstsha btab par/ slar yang rab gnas dang sngags nyis 'bum bzlas pa'i sgrub pa tshul bzhin du bya ba la sogs pa'i dgongs pa 'gengs byed phal cher grub nas/ mchod rten bya ba ni/ spyir de bzhin gshegs pas mdzad pa khyad par can gong du bstan pa der sku gdung cha brgyad kyi mchod rten byung ste/ de'ang sa skya gong du mchod rten gang byung tshigs su bcad par bsdebs na/ pad spungs bltams tshe ser skya'i drung du dar// byang chen rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe rdo rje'i gdan// sgo mang chos 'khor bskor tshe 'khor mo 'jig /cho 'phrul cho 'phrul bstan tshe mnyan yod du// lha babs yum gyi don mdzad gsal ldan grong*// dbyen 'dum dge 'dun 'dum tshe yangs pa can// sku tshe byin rlabs rnam rgyal rgyal po'i khab// myangs 'das mdzad pa tha mar rtswa mchog grong*// zhes pa ltar brgyad las 'dir dge 'dun dbyen 'dum gyi mchod rten la dper byas pa bskrun pa'i las byed pa'i gtso bo ngag dbang bsam 'phel bzhugs nas/ dpal 'byor gling du me khyi'i bgrang gzhi shar ba'i rgyu skar lha mo nag pas nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la 'go brtsams te/ mgar dpon tshe ring skyabs sogs mgar ba bcu gnyis/ zangs phyi ba 'gu ru srung sogs drug brkos pa tshe srung sogs gsum/ shing bzo dba' tsha sogs lnga/ bri thig lha pa bzod pa bzang po rnams bsags te/ zla tshes dge ba'i nyin mo nas brtsams te/ mchod rten gyi cha tshad kyang bu ston dang sprul sku 'phrang kha ba thar rtse pa sogs kyi cha tshad mang du mchis mod/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs dang mthun par bai ḍūr g.ya' sel nas 'byung ba'i tshad nyid bzo legs pa gtso bor bzung nas/

mtho tshad dgu'i tshad yod par/ las byed pa kun kyang nang shing phyi gser zangs phra rgyan gyi bar gyi bya ba thams cad rang rang gi ngos nas 'bad rtsol chen pos legs par bsgrubs pas/ lo de'i rgyu skar smin drug dga' mas nya ba'i zhag mdzod kyi tshes bcu dgu nyin grub par byas so// de dag la dgos pa'i dngos rdzas la/ rgya thur gyis gzhal ba'i srang nyer drug la rgya gang brtsis pa'i zangs rgya drug cu re gcig nyag bdun/ ti tsha srang bcu gnyis/ gser srang bcu dang zho lnga/ dngul chu srang brgya dang gnyis zho 'khor lnga/ phra rgyan byi ru rdog po che chung rnams la srang sum cu so dgu'i bab song*/ phra khang sogs la dngul srang nyer bdun/ lha lcam bkra shis dbang mo nas g.yu drug bse gcig dang*/ yang rdog po gsum/ tshe ring nor bu spun gyi gser srang lnga/ dngul chu bcas/ zangs rgya dgu/ byi ru rgyal mo lag pa gnyis/ 'phar ja ko tse bag gnyis/ gzhung ja 'khor drug gcig mar de'i 'grigs/ bla ma gzungs lhog gi byi ru/ rnam skyabs zangs sogs dang dga' ston/ tshe ring rdo rje pha bu'i g.yu rdog po/ dga' ston bzang ja rnams byung*/ bzo pa thams cad la mgo brtsams te mtha' ma 'dus par dga' ston zho rgyun chags drang ba dang*/ skabs skabs su bzang ja/ 'bras/ sha mar thud chang sogs kyis dga' ston gya nom pa bgyis/ las byed pa thams cad la gsol chas kyi ched du song ba bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug brgyad/ mar rgya sum brgya dang dgu bcu go lnga/ nas khal brgya dang drug cu re dgu/ chan btso rgyu gro khal nyer gsum dang zho gsum song*/ bzo mgar sogs yon 'bul gyis ma mnyes na/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mi 'chag gsungs pa ltar/ yon 'bul thams cad zhib rtsis su bsdoms pas ja brgyad cu gya dgu dang sbag gsum bcas kyis so sor tshim zhing mnyes par byas so// nang rten la/ dbus su srog shing la 'dri 'jug gi cho ga tshul bzhin du byas nas/

thog mar de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung mdun rin po che nas byung ba sogs drug sa ngor gyi phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rten 'dam dpe bral ma sogs mang po dang*/ sde dge gong ma rim byon rnams kyis bsags pa'i 'phags bod yul gyi bla ma mkhas grub mang po'i dbu lo/ phyag sen/ gdung thal/ gdung rus/ na bza' sogs phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i rten 'dam la btab pa'i sku brnyan gyi rigs mang po dang*/ dpal sa skya sogs nas byon pa'i gdung tsha'i sku brnyan mang po dang*/ khams pa nas byung ba'i spyan ras gzigs bzhengs sku gcig tshe dpag sku brnyan gcig dam rdzas ril bu stong do gcig brgya do mang po dang dam rdzas sil bu'i rigs tshan che ba bzhugs shing*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel la lhun grub steng 'dir par du bkod pa'i gzungs la/ ka nas cha'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams kyi gzungs tshar lnga dang*/ de dag gi gseb tshag rnams su gong du smos pa'i ring bsrel dang rten 'dam gyi rigs dang*/ chos 'khor bcu gsum nas bre yan chad du dam rdzas brgya do sil ma'i rigs phon che ba rnams bzhugs/ bum pa'i stod kun tu ja gong ma ste kye rdo rje dus 'khor bde mchog gsang 'dus gshin rje gshed sogs rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i gzungs rnams dang*/ ja 'og ma la rnal 'byor rgyud dang spyod pa dang bya ba'i rgyud skor gyi gzungs cha lag dang bcas pa ste de dag tshar bcu re dang*/ ta pa gzungs chen sde lnga ste de dag ni stod smad kun tu khyab par bzhugs so// bang rim rnams su tha pa mdo gzungs dang*/ nyer mkho chos chung gi rigs rnams/ de yan chad kyi bar mtshams kun tu rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyi gdung rus las grub pa'i sātstsha tshul bzhin bsgrub pa rnams bzhugs/ seng khri man chad du da na ste chos srung nor lha'i skor/ pa pha 'dod gsol bkra shis kyi skor te mdo gzungs man chad 'di dag tshar sum cu las mi nyung ba bzhugs shing*/

gnod sbyin bang mdzod du tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo'i rigs mang po dang*/ nor bum dang*/ klu bum dang*/ rgya bod dang gnas chen rnams kyi sa sna dang*/ sman khrob kyi rigs mang po dang*/ shing thog 'bras/ gro ma/ gro nas sogs 'bru rigs dang*/ rgya ja'i rigs/ gos ling*/ sman tse/ ras/ gser/ dngul/ zangs/ mu tig byi ru/ spos shel/ dung*/ mu men sogs rin po che'i rigs mang po dang lhan cig tu bzhugs te/ byin rten gdung tsha gzungs la sogs pa 'di dag thams cad dar ras ser pos na bza' khug ma dang bcas te bar mtshams med par phyur bur gtams te bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ bum sgo'i nang du tsandan dkar po las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi sku gser zhal dar gyi na bza' dang bcas te rgyal khab chen po'i gser gdung khang du bzhugs khri la mnga' gsol ba'i steng du/ dpon lcam zung nas gos rdo rje srang lam can gyi bla bre zur skor phur ma sman tses byas pa lcags ri bcas dang*/ mdun chas nar ma la rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ me tog za ma tog spyi blugs/ snyan shal la mdzod btags ring ba dkar/ shug tshang dmar/ ser/ ljang*/ sngo/ li khri/ yang shug tshang dkar/ dmar/ ser/ ljang*/ dmar skya/ sman tse/ yang kha btags/ lcam gyi snyan shal kha btags/ sman tse/ ling*/ gsum pa brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dgos pa'ang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ gang du rten bzhengs grub ma thag /byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na// de la bkra mi shis 'byung zhing*// de srid mchod pa der mi 'os// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rten bzhengs grub nas rab tu gnas pas byin gyis ma brlabs par ring du gnas na/ der bgegs 'jug pa la sogs pas mi shis pa 'byung ba dang*/ de srid du mchod pa bya ba'i 'os su mi 'gyur bas/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bya ba la'ang*/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/ rab gnas rten dang slob dpon dus// gnas dang yo byad cho ga bzang*// zhes 'byung ba ltar drug las/

de ltar tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rten de la rab gnas kyi cho ga bgyid pa'i slob dpon gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin cing*/ sbyin sreg dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ 'di'i cho ga la mkhas pa zhig dgos te/ de'ang rdo rje slob dpon kho bo cag gtso bor bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su 'os pa'i dge 'dun bcas pas dus ni/ legs sbyar skad du/ akṣa ya zhes pa/ stod 'grel las/ mi zad ces dang*/ ma hā tsi na'i skad du/ bing thu'i zhes bod/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming la me khams kyi ku ku ra/ srog lus gnyis ka 'od srung byin/ klung rta sra brtan lcags/ sme ba dgu gling dbus zhugs bu ga khong nong gi lo/ spen klung*/ 'byung ba sum ldan shar ba'i zhag gi phung po hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi gza' dkar po dang*/ skar ma tha skar 'dzom pa'i dus su gnas de nyid du tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i yo byad dang*/ rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i cho gas rab tu gnas par byas pas mchod sdong chen po'i rdul phra rab re'i gor yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin du bzhugs su gsol te/ lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu ma lus pa'i phyag mchod bya ba'i yul mchog tu gyur pa bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po skad cig rer yang rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i mchod sdong chen po nyid du mngon par grub zin pas/ 'di phyir legs par 'dod pa'i blo gros can rnams kyi yid ches pa'i gnas su bgyid par 'tshal lo// smras pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa shākya seng ge yis// 'gro ba 'dul ba'i ngo mtshar khyad par can// gong du brten pa'i gnas der mchod pa'i rten// ring bsrel ldan pa legs bzang rnams kyis brtsigs// de dag rnams las lhas byin dbyen gyi rgyus// dge 'dun bye ba ston mchog thugs rje ches// 'dum mdzad tshe na byung ba'i dbyen 'dum la// phyi mor bgyis pa bsod nams zhing du bskrun// mu med zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas la// phyag mchod bkur stir bgyis pa'i bsod nams mthu// gcig tu mngon par rdzogs la mchod pa'i ched// dkar po'i phyogs kyi lha rnams nyin bzhin lhags// phyi dbyibs tshad kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa la// nang du chos gzugs ring bsrel snying po can// gsang bar mchod yul grangs med rgyal ba'i zhing*// tshul 'di bskrun pa'i dge bas dus gsum gyi// sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa rgyud bla ma yi// zab dgongs rdzogs shing las bzang 'brel thogs kyis// nyer mtshon 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis byang gyur cig

/sras bcas rgyal ba'i phrin las nyin mor byed// smra mkhas bye ba'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis// skye dgu'i bsod nams bla na rtag 'bar zhing*// bde skyid sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rgyas gyur cig /tshul 'dir 'brel thogs kyis mtshon mar gyur 'gro// mi khom brgyad du nam yang mi skye zhing*// dal 'byor dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su thob// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin gyur cig /ces rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho pa sogs 'dren mchog gong ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs su dge 'dun dbyen 'dum gyi mchod rten chen po bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dwangs shel me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong chen po'i zhom ring pa dge slong tshul khrims phun tshogs sogs kyis bskul ngor/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gsel lcags yos kyi bgrang gzhi'i dus 'khor ba'i ston 'bring po yar ngo sngon 'gro bu mo'i khyim/ hor lugs dang gso ba rig pa 'dzin pa'i zla ba brgyad pa bya zla ba/ spar kha ging*/ sme ba drug dkar/ dbyangs 'char lugs la/ dbyangs ai/ gsal byed ṭa/ 'byung ba rlung*/ rten 'brel reg pa/ rgyu skar khrums kyi dga' mas nya ba'i dmar phyogs kyi stong pa gnyis pa/ dar gud lang tsho/ nyi ma lug dus 'khor lugs kyi dbyangs ai/ gsal byed dhai/ mdza' lha'i grogs po gza' lhag pa/ sbyin mo'i lha mo skar ma rgyal stod/ 'phrod chen glang po/ 'phrod chung chu rlung 'dzom pa'i nyin sde dge lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i nye 'dabs chu lha'i phyogs kyi bsti gnas su grub par bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// bkod bzhag smras don khur len 'dzol med dgos pa 'gyur med gtan tshigs rdo rje'i rgya mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru mo gha siddha ya/ gang la gus pas gsol ba btab tsam gyis// bsam don ji snyed gegs med 'grub byed pa// mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas dkon mchog gsum// brtsams don bskal par 'grub pa'i dge legs stsol// phyi nang dkon mchog gsum po rten gyi skyabs// nges bzung tshul khrims gsum gyi bslab pa la// gus pa lhur byed gtsug lag rin chen gyi// snang ba yongs bzung rgyal ba'i myu gu pa// kho bor mdo sngags smra ba'i slob dpon du// legs par rtogs nas gtsug lag phyi nang gi

/gzhung lugs kun dang dbang lung zab khrid kyi// bslab bya mang thos dad ldan slob bu dag /skye ba 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// 'bral med spyi bo'i gtsug tu mnyam 'grogs shing*// zab rgyas chos tshul gaṅgā'i rgyun chen ltar// rtag 'jo smon lam mgron du gnyer bya'i phyir// zla dus mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar te// gsol 'debs smon lam lag pa brgya spyod cing*// gnas skabs mthar thug ci 'dod snye ma 'bum// 'bral med bsod nams khang par 'gugs byed pa// dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur rgyun// bskal pa'i yun du gnas phyir de'i rten du// las byed do dam khur len gcig nas gcig /rtsis sprod 'phyugs med yi ge'i bden dpang bzhag /yid 'phrog 'dab stong rgyas pa'i bcud len phyir// rkang drug mgrin pa'i dbyangs chung len byed na// 'di nas byang chub bar gyi bde legs mgron// gnyer ba'i tshul 'dir spro ba mi bskyed su// de'ang phul byung bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los tha gru rnam par yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' bsgyur ba sde dge sa skyong rim byon rnams kyis mchod gnas su bkur ba'i dgon sde mang du mchis pa'i ya gyal rdzong chen mgos chos sde bkra shis lhas rtsen zhes bya bar 'du ba'i ngur smrig 'chang gi bla chos dge 'dun 'dus pa las byed dang bcas pa rnams kyis nges byar/ spyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la 'os pa'i bya ba byas shing*/ sgos su rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen po rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa zhes grags pa'i dbyangs snyan srid pa gsum gyi khongs na ldir ba de nyid yab sras gdan rabs rim par byon pa rnams kyi legs gsungs 'chi ba med pa'i zil dngar gyis mngon mtho nges legs kyi lang tsho dar bab bskyed par brten/ gang de'i lugs bzang dri ma med pa la dad gus kyi srog ka brtan par gyur nas/

mkhas tshul gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i byi dor cung zad bgyis pa'i zhus dag pa tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pa bdag la phyi nang rig pa'i gtsug lag gi bslab bya'i tshul legs par thos pa dang*/ rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang bskur byin rlabs zab khrid gdams pa'i tshogs dag nod pa'i slob bu dge slong lhun grub phun tshogs dang*/ zla rgyud kyi rdzong sdod mgon po zhes bgyi ba gnyis kyis/ gong du smos pa'i spyi bye brag gi sku drin che ba'i dri bzo dang*/ nang sgos su rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba ma byung ba la/ ba tsha chu klung gi mdo las/ bskal pa snyigs mar gyur pa tshe// nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyis gnas// nga yin snyam du yid byos la// de tshe de la gus pa bskyed// ces dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ gang zhig dbang bskur sbyin byed pa// de ni rdor sems lta bur blta// bla ma ston pa bas lhag blta// yid bzhin rin chen mnyam par blta// zhes sangs rgyas dngos su mjal ba lta bur blta dgos par gsungs pa dang*/ de la mchod pa phul bas bsod nams rgya chen thob pa'ang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen nyid// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la mchod pa byas pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byug pa phan yon che'o// zhes sogs mang du 'byung ba rnams kyis yid nye bar drangs te/ rang gi rnam thar gyi yi ge 'dri dgos par thog mar bskul ba na/ rang gi byas byung gang dran bris yod pa ltar/ de rjes de dag gzugs ris su bkod pa'i thang ka lnga re bris pa rgyan ldan bkod legs byas pa dang*/ yang lhun grub phun tshogs kho nas thub pa gnas brtan gyis bskor ba dang*/

lam 'bras thang sku sa chen/ kun dga' bzang po/ dpal chos/ dkon mchog grags pa rnams gtso bor byas pa'i zhal thang lnga/ gser zangs las grub pa'i kho bo'i 'dra sku bzhengs pa rnams mchod yul du bzhag nas/ de dag gi mdun du nyer spyod 'bul ba'i li'i ting phor bdun/ rag gi ting phor bdun/ rag gi spos 'dzin/ mar me'i kong bu/ lcags kyi man 'ji/ rgya li'i maṇḍal/ rag gser gyi maṇḍal/ mu tig phreng bsgrigs kyi lcags ri/ shel sgong lnga bcas/ ka ṭo ra/ rdor dril/ sil snyan/ phud kong*/ bla bre 'brug ris can/ thang ka'i 'dogs thags lcags phur 'byar ba/ phyi g.yogs ras phyar/ bzhugs khang sgam bu lcags gzer bcas bzhag nas/ ji srid bskal pa nam gnas kyi zla re bzhin gyi tshes la dge slong bco lnga re chag nongs med par/ dkar cha bzhi/ dkon mchog rjes dran/ thub bstod/ ltung bshags/ ji snyed su dag byang chub snying po'i sems bskyed/ zhi gdong ma/ za hor ma/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis chu gter rdzogs pa'i sprin chen/ smon lam bde legs mdza' bo 'gugs pa'i pho nya bcas dang*/ gnas brtan phyag mchod/ kun khyab ma/ chos spyod stod smad rdzogs pa/ bdag gi bstod pa zla snang 'bab stegs/ bla ma rgyang 'bod/ smon lam rnam lnga/ sgrol ma/ zab mdo/ 'gro la bde skyid bcas pa 'don dgos pa'i nyer spyod chas mchod rtsam 'dong bzhi dang mchod 'bru bre gang dngos gtsang*/ mchod mar sgron me brgyad bcas la mar srang bco lnga/ gsol ja 'dren phog lnga la dang po gnyis la mchod zhal gsum re/ de rjes gsum la do re bcas pa'i khyon mchod zhal bcu gnyis re la ja 'dong phyed gsum/ gsol rtsam 'dong bco lnga/ yon 'bul nas 'dong lnga re'am/ ja 'dong re gang 'byor byed pa las tshwa du ba ni bkye mi chog cing*/ de dag gi rten la gzhung ja 'khor drug nyi shu tham pa kho rang gnyis thun mong nas bzhag pa 'di/ las byed pa gcig nas gcig tu rtsis sprod bskal pa ji srid bar byed dgos pa bla chos dge 'dun kun gyi nges pa ltar sprad nas/

de'i khe skyed kyi 'phel ba gang byung gi mchod nas gsol yon gyi rgyu byed cing*/ slar rtsis sprad la rtsa ba dngos ja mdo byung kho na blang len byed dgos par zhus dag bla ma dang*/ zhi tsha lhun grub phun tshogs/ zla rgyud rdzong sdod mgon po spun bcas nas bzhag pa 'di la slan chad drag zhan sus kyang bzo bcos bsgyur bgod byed mi chog pa'i yi ge 'di la/ gal te brnyas sems gal chung ham spyod kyis 'don brjod gsol yon mi grangs chag 'phri sogs byed pa byung tshe/ bstan srung bran du 'khol ba dbang bla'i bka' gtad dmod bskul ltar dang*/ bdag cag gis kyang rtag tu bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha srung ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog pho nya sde tshogs bcas dang*/ gnyan mgon chen po gdong bzhi pa/ yum chen bzhi/ 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang*/ bka' sdod drag rtsal che ba gnod sbyin chen po beg tse lcam sring*/ las mkhan srog bdag dmar po/ gri thogs shan pa brgyad/ ro shan nyi shu rtsa gcig btsan dmar stong*/ bdud dang gnod sbyin/ srin po sum stong*/ ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong gi 'khor tshogs sprul pa yang sprul bcas dang*/ gzhan yang dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra ming sring*/ ru 'dren sde tshogs/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ bdud phrug bye ba'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa de dag kun gyi las byed shan pa sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rngam pa'i tshogs rnams kyis lo zla ma 'gyang bar rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston la/ tshe'i 'du byed sdus/ srog gi rgyun thag chod/ las ngan gyi 'phra rgyun myur du gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig tshul 'dir bsam sbyor rnam par dag pas bcol don gegs med bsgrub cing*/ bla ma dkon mchog snying thag pa nas mchod cing bsnyen bkur yang dag bgyid pa rnams kyi/

tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor dang blo gros thams cad bla nas bla mar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ 'di phyi'i don kun gegs bral yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las dang stong grogs mdzod cig smras don 'di dang 'gal byed gang byung ba'i// tshe srog rgyun chod dpal mgon srung ma'i tshogs// bsgo ba tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skal bzang rnams// tshe dang bsod nams bde 'byor rgyas par mdzod// ces bskul ba dang*/ rnam pa gcig tu na bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chos ldan sa skyong chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa lcam dral nas bka' tham bka' lung gi bkod pa bcas bzhag pa 'di la/ slad char sde dge mi ngo gang dag 'byon 'gyur thams cad nas ma 'phyugs par brtse gzigs lhod med kyis bskyang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ zhus dag bla ma 'di spyi dang bye brag nged cag gi bstan don la zhus dag sogs phan 'dogs kyi drin chen zla bral yin gshis/ gong du smras don ji snyed khur len 'dzol med dgos pa 'gyur med gtan tshigs kyi rdo rje'i rgya mdzes zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags stag zla tshes la dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nas bris/ zhes pa chos ldan sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho pa dang dgongs mthun du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
